messages:
Maya Chen: FYI I merged Polestar's customer LoRA into the staging branch and kicked off a quickpack. Noticing token duplication when contexts > 1024 tokens. Running a focused warmstart/kv test now.

Trent O'Neill: ugh. saw similar on an internal replica last week but only with int4 quant. Can you paste the failing prompt sample?

Maya Chen: sample attached inline: 'Prompt: Explain the transaction history from 2019 to present...' repeats 'In summary' twice around token ~1150.

Liam Park: did you repro on float32 / int8?

Maya Chen: float32 clean, int8 small diffs but no duplication, int4 shows repeats. eval-bot ran a short batch:
```
$ rw-eval run --suite polestar-warmstart --model /staging/polestar-lora:merged --quant int4 --batch 4 --longctx 2048
```

eval-bot: Quickpack finished. Summary: 120 long-context samples. Token-dup rate: baseline (float32) 0.7%, int8 1.1%, int4 3.5%. Median latency int4 +18% vs f32 on same infra. See /tmp/eval-polestar-173890 for logs. :warning:

Trent O'Neill: ok that points to quantization amplification of a KV warmstart edge. Could be our attention kernel under low-precision when cache gets paged/warmed.

Liam Park: can we isolate by disabling prefix cache to see if repeats disappear?

Maya Chen: disabling prefix cache now and re-run small batch.

infra-bot: started a dedicated pod polestar-warm-173890 with `gpu: a100-s` and `mem: 96G`

Maya Chen: ran without prefix cache: duplication down to 0.9% on int4. Looks like cache interaction.

Trent O'Neill: sweet. next steps: 1) try alternative kv-layout (interleaved) 2) recompile attention kernel with relaxed accumulation precision 3) set rollout hold for this model.

Liam Park: I'll push a quick kernel shim to test relaxed accumulation (accumulator=fp16->fp32 path) and rerun the pack with same seeds.

Maya Chen: added rollout hold tag to staging: `hold:polestar-lora-warmstart` and notified SE. Also uploaded the failing evalpack to S3: s3://redwood-evals/polestar/173890-pack.zip

Trent O'Neill: action items assigned: Trent -> kernel shim experiment, Liam -> reproduce with kv-layout toggles, Maya -> coordinate customer communication + full evalpack. Re-run ETA ~2h.

eval-bot: note: please include random_seed and deterministic decoding flags when re-running to ensure reproducibility.

Maya Chen: noted. will include `--seed 42 --decoding greedy` on the next run. thanks. :thumbsup:
